question: Which date will the Bal Sahitya Puraskar 2025 be presented?
solution:
The correct answer is __**14 November 2025.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Bal Sahitya Puraskar 2025 will be presented on 14 November 2025, coinciding with Children’s Day.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The awards will be presented at the Triveni Auditorium, New Delhi.
 
• This ceremony will celebrate children's literature in 24 Indian languages.
 
• It is a prestigious event organized by Sahitya Akademi to recognize contributions to children's literature.
 
• In addition to the award, each winner receives ₹50,000 and a bronze plaque.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Sahitya Akademi__

 
 
• Founded in - 1954
 
• Headquarters - New Delhi
 
• President - Madhav Kaushik
